preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of edges in the tree is between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all((1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N) for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each node in the edges is between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: No self-loops are present in the edges.

preconditions.expression: all(u in edges and v in edges for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: The graph is a valid tree, meaning it is connected and has no cycles.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of nodes selected is at least 1.
The minimum number of nodes selected is at most N.
For a tree with 3 nodes and 2 edges, the minimum number of nodes selected is 1.
For a tree with 6 nodes and the given edges, the minimum number of nodes selected is 2.
